description: The source records adult emergency-shelter use in Alberta. Listed variables include date, shelter name, approved beds, beds funded by Assisted Living and Social Services, beds funded for winter emergency response, and daily occupancy. A CSV spans 2013–2025 alongside overlapping annual and multiyear spreadsheets, plus usage notes and a service-region map. Metadata ends in June 2025. These are accommodation capacity and service-load observations; differing funding and approved-bed measures must remain distinct. The data bodies and usage-notes PDF were not read. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
